title: Late Payment Charges Returned With a Metering Service Fast-Meter Refund
content:
Late payment charges posted on the Electric Service Agreement within the whole calendar months the **Metering Service** fast-meter refund covers, counted from the handling date as the covered bills are, were computed on overstated bills. These are the late payment charges posted in the same months, reckoned back from the handling date, as the bills the refund covers.

**General service schedules.** Where the agreement is on a general service schedule (GS, GST, GD or LP) and such late payment charges exist, the corrected late payment charges are those charges times the fast-meter error factor, rounded to the cent.

**Residential schedules.** Where the agreement is on a residential schedule (RS, RT or REV) and such late payment charges exist, the corrected late payment charges are all of those charges.

**No such charges.** Where no late payment charge was posted within those months, no late payment charge is corrected.

## Decision table

| Schedule of the agreement | Late payment charges posted within the covered months | Corrected late payment charges |
|---|---|---|
| GS, GST, GD or LP | Yes | Those charges times the fast-meter error factor, rounded to the cent |
| RS, RT or REV | Yes | All of those charges |
| Any | None | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- Schedule GS, late payment charges of 12.00 and 9.60 within the covered months, fast-meter error factor of 0.0291262: 21.60 times 0.0291262 is 0.63 after rounding to the cent.
- Schedule RT with the same two late payment charges: all 21.60 is returned.
